messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content: 當球被投擲向上時，雖然它最初有 5 m/s 的上升速度，但在空氣阻力忽略不計的情況下，唯一持續作用於它的力是重力。這會使球受到向下的加速度，大小約為 \(g \approx 9.8\ \text{m/s}^2\)。因此，球在上升過程中會經歷大約 \(-9.8\ \text{m/s}^2\) 的加速度（負號表示方向與初始速度相反）。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？" They want to know what acceleration it will reach? Actually they might be confused: If a ball is thrown upward at 5 m/s, what acceleration will it have? The answer: It will experience downward acceleration due to gravity of about -9.8 m/s^2 (assuming Earth). So we can respond accordingly. No tool needed.
